description: Round-trips a small public www.opentable.com URL (/robots.txt) through ContextMint Bridge (your signed-in browser tab) and returns diagnostics: the bridge's role (host/peer/null), port, version, the extension link (linked / pair pending / not attached / never answered), the elapsed round-trip time, and a plain-English hint distinguishing 'bridge never came up' from 'extension not connected' from 'this browser can't serve a capability' from 'real www.opentable.com-side problem'. Read-only, no auth required. Tests bridge transport only. Search/menus/availability are reported only from observed real reads; booking is never probed.
name: opentable_healthcheck
